answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at signed bicycle sharing ride history with city operator attestation. It requires a ride history the city operator logged over two years, so the ocean of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The summit is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The ember is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
